familytree.screen.browser.title: Family Tree - Tracked Pets
familytree.screen.view.title: Family Tree of %s
familytree.screen.empty: No pets found here yet. Visit your pets and choose Find existing pets. Their parents stay unknown until you link them.
familytree.screen.no_matches: No pets match these filters. Clear the search or choose All.
familytree.welcome: Your pets' family history is now being recorded. Press %s to open Family Tree. Existing pets appear as you visit them.
familytree.access.denied: Only a pet's owner or a server operator can locate or change that pet.
familytree.export.failed: Could not save the image. Check the game log and try again.
familytree.export.too_large: Hide some branches or open a smaller family before exporting.
familytree.not_available: This server needs the matching version of Family Tree to open the screen.
familytree.screen.settings.title: Family Tree Settings
familytree.screen.tree.branch_hint: Hide or show all descendants of the selected pet, including shared descendants.
familytree.screen.tree.controls: Click to select, double-click to open a tree
familytree.screen.tree.pan_controls: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom
familytree.rename.title: Rename in Family Tree
familytree.rename.hint: This only changes the name in Family Tree. The animal's name in the world stays the same.
familytree.rename.label: Name in family tree
familytree.rename.not_found: This pet is no longer in the family tree.
familytree.rename.not_allowed: Only this pet's owner or a server operator can rename it.
familytree.rename.invalid: Use 1 to 64 characters without formatting codes or line breaks.
familytree.rename.unsupported: This server does not support renaming yet.
familytree.rename.failed: The name could not be saved. Try again.
familytree.rename.timeout: No reply yet. Reopen the tree to check whether the name was saved.
familytree.command.scan.result: Family Tree scan complete: imported %s pets, refreshed %s existing records.
familytree.command.locate.deceased: %s died on day %s. Last known location:
familytree.command.locate.no_position: No known location for %s yet. Try /familytree scan while the pet is loaded.
familytree.command.pair.same_parent: Parent A and Parent B must be different pets.
familytree.command.pair.child_matches_pa: The child must be different from both parents.
familytree.command.pair.species_mismatch: Use pets of the same species, or a horse and donkey as parents of a mule.
familytree.command.pair.cycle: Cannot link these pets. A pet cannot be its own ancestor.
familytree.command.setage.invalid: Cannot set age to %s days when the latest valid world day is %s.
familytree.command.setage.result: Set %s to %s days old. Birth day is now %s.
familytree.command.setbirth.invalid: Cannot set birth day to %s when the latest valid world day is %s.
familytree.command.setbirth.result: Set %s to be born on day %s. Relative age is now %s days.
familytree.command.info.help.title: Family Tree tracks your tamed pets, breeding lines, names, ownership, and deaths.
familytree.command.info.help.summary: Use the Family Tree screen to browse pets and lineage, or use commands to manage data directly.
familytree.command.info.help.commands: Commands: /familytree list, /familytree scan, /familytree pair, /familytree unpair, /familytree setage, /familytree setbirth, /familytree prune, /familytree info <name>.
familytree.command.info.help.scan: /familytree scan imports already-tamed pets that are loaded in the world.
familytree.command.info.help.pair: /familytree pair links two parents to a child record.
familytree.command.info.help.unpair: /familytree unpair clears the parent links from a child record.
familytree.command.info.help.setage: /familytree setage changes a pet to a relative age in world days, for example 15 days old.
familytree.command.info.help.setbirth: /familytree setbirth sets the pet's birth day directly, for example born on day 20.
familytree.tool.not_tamed: That animal is not tamed, so it cannot be linked.
familytree.screen.load_failed: No complete reply. Choose Refresh or reopen the screen.
familytree.parents.title: Parents of %s
familytree.parents.hint: Choose two parents, then confirm. This changes the recorded family, not the animals in your world.
familytree.parents.clear_hint: The pet and its descendants stay in the tree.
familytree.parents.distinct: Choose two different parents. Neither can be the child.
familytree.parents.failed: The pet record changed. Refresh the tree and try again.
familytree.parents.no_candidates: No pets match. Try another name or visit your pets first.
familytree.help.title: Start a pet family tree
familytree.help.discover: Visit pets you already have, then choose Find existing pets. Only loaded tamed pets can be discovered.
familytree.help.parents: Older parents are unknown. Open a pet, select it, and choose Add parents to record a family you remember. You must own all three pets or be an operator.
familytree.help.breed: Breed pets while Family Tree is installed. New children keep their parent links. Deceased pets keep their place in the family.
familytree.help.export: Choose Export family tree, then Open folder to find the PNG. Hide branches to make a smaller image. The file stays on your computer.
familytree.command.cooldown: Please wait two seconds before requesting another scan or edit.
familytree.command.read_only: Family Tree found an unsupported save format. Edits are disabled to preserve the original data. Check the server log.
familytree.command.ambiguous: More than one pet matches '%s'. Use an exact UUID from the choices below.
familytree.command.backup: Saved a backup in familytree-backups/%s before pruning.
familytree.command.backup_failed: Prune canceled because a backup could not be saved. Check the server log.
